articles.title: Putin's nuclear build-up on NATO's doorstep: Russia transports nukes to Belarus as allies rehearse strikes on the West
articles.summary: Russia has delivered tactical nuclear munitions to storage facilities in Belarus, coinciding with major military exercises. This action significantly escalates tensions with Western nations amidst the ongoing conflict in Ukraine. The move underscores Russia's assertive military posture and its willingness to deploy strategic assets in the region, drawing strong international concern regarding regional stability and nuclear proliferation.

articles.title: Patlabor EZY 'File 1' Film Opens at #8, Live-Action Shōjiki Fudōsan Opens at #4
articles.summary: Nintendo, Illumination, and Universal Pictures have announced 'The Super Mario Galaxy Movie,' a sequel building upon the success of 'The Super Mario Bros. Movie.' This collaboration aims to further expand the cinematic universe of Nintendo's iconic Super Mario video game franchise, continuing their partnership in animated entertainment.

articles.title: Headline: HVR Solar to commission 1.2 GW module manufacturing plant in Sonipat this June 2026
articles.summary: HVR Solar begins commercial operations at its new 1.2 GW solar module manufacturing plant, a strategic step to boost India's renewable energy transition. This significantly enhances domestic production capabilities, fostering energy independence and contributing to the nation's green economy goals. Such initiatives are vital for sustainable national development.

articles.title: Police killed or injured their loved ones. Grief turned these 3 strangers into allies
articles.summary: The provided text highlights the profound trauma experienced by families whose loved ones die during police interventions, whether through beatings or shootings. It emphasizes the lack of clear guidance or support for parents after witnessing such fatal encounters with law enforcement, underscoring a systemic issue regarding accountability and victim support within the country's justice system.

articles.title: Tribunal into missing Indigenous children and unmarked graves to hold sessions in Montreal
articles.summary: An international tribunal is scheduled to convene in Montreal next week, investigating missing children and unmarked graves associated with Canada's residential school system. This session aims to address historical injustices and alleged atrocities within these institutions. The ongoing probe underscores global efforts towards uncovering truth and promoting accountability for past human rights abuses, marking a significant international development.

articles.title: survrm2py added to PyPI
articles.summary: survRM2py is a new Python software library, a re-implementation of the existing R package `survRM2` for Restricted Mean Survival Time (RMST) analysis. This tool aims for exact mathematical accuracy with its R counterpart. Such statistical tools are crucial in fields like medical research for analyzing survival data, potentially aiding advancements in healthcare and scientific understanding.
